prompt.project_info: Create a very realistic front-facing motorcycle portrait of one approved adult man in formal tailoring and a vintage helmet against a vibrant yellow background.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult man seated on a motorcycle, wearing a formal navy suit, white shirt, black tie, and vintage leather motorcycle helmet with goggles. He has a joyful wide smile; wind visibly moves the tie and suit fabric while the staged studio composition conveys motion.
composition_elements: Front-facing portrait from the motorcycle handlebars.
Motorcycle headlight, chrome bars, helmet, suit, and expressive face clearly visible.
Wind movement across the face and tie creates dynamic energy without unsafe road depiction.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even studio light with crisp highlights on chrome and helmet, bold yellow color field, energetic joyful atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon EOS R5 look, high resolution, ultra-realistic details, realistic skin, tailoring, leather, metal, and wind movement, portrait composition, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A very realistic front-facing photograph of an approved adult man sitting on a motorcycle. He wears a formal navy suit, white shirt, black tie and a vintage leather helmet with goggles, and his face shows great happiness. Wind blows visibly against his face and suit, creating a dynamic sensation of movement as if traveling at high speed. The overall scene is set against a vibrant yellow background, capturing the realism of a person enjoying a motorcycle ride with clear focus on facial expression and the effect of the wind. Captured with the Canon EOS R5 camera with high resolution and ultra-realistic details, no text, no watermark.
